description:
Display-managed masks, implicit surface defaults and silhouette-only selection could hide geometry errors. This PR adds calibrated linear-alpha measurements, authored editable shape controls and bounded producer ownership, keeping silhouette, surface, topology, editability and artist verdicts independent.

## Published calibration and current demo through d11

Current head: `7d64b0cd9f549a2e4e7cc51ab548662e3c8c0136`, targeting `main` at `d5e981659a18c435ccbe7cc072b873e5b1707645`. Main is an ancestor of the PR head. The current PR stays draft; no retarget, merge or Pages deployment has occurred.

- Complete the frozen 12-family matrix with depth, cavity and missing-part negative controls, physical source edits and exact indexed restoration. The current presentation binds 12 retained actual bodies and 60/60 original required view gates; engineering completion is shown separately from artist acceptance (one accepted vase, eleven unqualified families).
- Add calibrated observed-contour/detail fitting, complementary-view diagnosis, authored rounded-box normal controls and rounded-triangle radius/thickness/front-back profile controls. Source certificates and actual camera/style evidence retain their independent scope; rejected sphere/ellipsoid updates and historical tail tradeoffs are preserved.
- Complete the previously missing canonical/native gates for the five named changed-positive checkpoints using bounded missing-only acquisitions. Original crops, normal behavior, source-owner limitations and independent boundary/edit receipts remain explicit.
- Own fresh render, variant, export and opt-in cache/numeric transports; preserve failed diagnostics and final outputs, use atomic no-clobber publication and bounded directly owned child supervision. Recovery inspection is read-only; there is no historical lease adoption or blanket deletion.
- Put the current 12-family view on the main demo while preserving historical navigation/assets. Actual headless Edge desktop interaction and layout checks passed, including current/historical views; mobile was skipped as requested. Evaluation Pages generation is manual-only, with publication disabled by default.

Validation for the published d11 stage: Adaptive CI policy checks and Blender Tests workflows succeeded at exact `d11d1b8`; older full/quick counts are not attributed to this head. Eight adverse current-demo data guards and the bounded desktop browser checks passed. Retained full Blender and seven-control 105-frame/seven-OBJ qualification remain their original evidence and were not rerun as missing. The published demo adds 29 bound current PNGs, with 115 public PNGs below the 15 MiB limit. No paid compute, package installation or version change was used.

Published details: [current-demo integration](https://github.com/doublemover/blendslop/blob/d11d1b84bd90d6265e59c0389c2b487fa90bcbcd/docs/quality-current-demo-integration-20261009/README.md), [completed generator checkpoint](https://github.com/doublemover/blendslop/blob/d11d1b84bd90d6265e59c0389c2b487fa90bcbcd/docs/quality-generator-restart-continuation-20261009/completed-checkpoint.json).

## Approved eight-commit continuation, now published

The owner approved the exact eight commits from `d11d1b8` through `7d64b0cd9f549a2e4e7cc51ab548662e3c8c0136`. They were published by nonforce fast-forward to this existing head branch and verified by both the remote ref and fresh PR API. The incremental bundle and per-batch evidence remain retained. Adaptive CI policy checks and Blender Tests both completed successfully at exact `7d64b0c` (runs 37979136302 and 37979136306). Detailed full/quick counts are not claimed for this head.

- Add explicit persistent-worker process budgets: one whole-pool deadline, split resource caps, bounded restarts, suspended-before-Job Windows launch, idle monitoring, exact descendant HANDLE joins and retryable incomplete stop. Fifteen affected ownership/compatibility methods passed; adoption by additional production callers remains work in progress.
- Bound cold DVX/native helper kill-drain-wait to one allowance, and bound legacy Poisson's final wait while preserving original exceptions and incomplete active leases. Fourteen helper guards plus two legacy guards passed.
- Remove the multipart dotted ledge with an explicit editable shared far-Y plane, add fully enclosed display framing without changing scored cameras, and integrate the relation into generic compilation before union evaluation. The actual generic/standalone `85dc` bodies match, with two live Exact unions and exact depth restoration. **Raw mean distance increases 8.75%; P95 is unchanged and sampled maximum drops 29.67%.** The tradeoff remains visible even though unchanged engineering thresholds pass.
- Improve the arch roof-only `4910` checkpoint: held-out alpha error drops 51.51%, raw mean 61.84%, and P95/maximum 87.03%; five original silhouettes, one uncached solid boundary and exact roof edit/restoration pass independently.
- Preserve both rejected triangle pose/profile proposals. The latest `4c677f` three-view correction lowers raw mean/P95/maximum 19.42%/42.47%/35.81%, but required held-out alpha worsens **0.97796266%**, so it remains rejected. Earlier `ddbf` worsens held-out alpha 36.11% and also remains rejected. Qualified `bfe` stays selected; passing silhouette/topology/edit checks do not override these failures.

Native validation for this eight-commit continuation was serial and bounded: 12 multipart frames; 12 arch/first-triangle frames acquired as five valid failed-scope alphas plus seven missing-only frames; one generic replay with zero frames; and six final triangle frames. The successful scopes retain exact HANDLE joins and empty Jobs. Latest triangle completed in 24.84 seconds, with all five observed HANDLEs joined, all 105 ordinary plus three toolchain input identities matched, and three separate read-only owner audits ready. Multipart producer reclamation remains blocked by six separately owned nested qualifier files; original failure scopes and all output are retained. No further broad historical comparison or full qualification campaign ran.

Remaining work is concrete additional caller-budget adoption/reclamation design, and a genuinely different triangle model only if source evidence supports a useful capability. Artist limits, global hidden-surface uniqueness and historical lost HANDLEs remain independent limitations. The approved push covers only through `7d64b0c`. Further caller-budget/reclamation/model implementation continues locally and is excluded from this head until separately approved. Merge and manual deployment require separate approval.
